title: At Most K Kinds
statement:
A conveyor belt carries `n` items in a row, and each item has a type number. A packing box can hold items of at most `k` different types. Find the longest block of consecutive items that fits in one box.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `k`. The second line contains `n` integers, the type of each item in order.

## Output
Print the length of the longest block of consecutive items that contains at most `k` different types.

## Constraints
- `1 <= k <= n <= 100000`
- `0 <= a_i <= 10^9`
